text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're here at the Grand Prix of dreams, the Arima Kinen. Everyone has their eyes on the star Umamusume, Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's rumored that Oguri Cap has been in poor form recently, but she laughs fearlessly despite the overwhelming pressure.
